svg.title: Case Study 48: 85-Day C-Suite Solution Roadmap
svg.desc: Eleven-session delivery roadmap with a protected finishing-margin week, covering evidence, role-agent research, architecture, synthetic data, prototype decisions, executive presentation, recovery gates and final decision capture.
svg.text: 11 delivery sessions finish 5 Dec | 6-13 Dec reserved for finishing margin and presentation
Start every session: 30-minute capacity and evidence review. End every session: 45-minute checkpoint.
Always label evidence as case-study fact, sector hypothesis/comparator, or unknown company detail. Record decisions, alternatives, trade-offs, owner and reversal condition.

text.tspan: • Define audience and exact final decision
• Write the first-10-minute promise and non-goals
• Reserve 11 delivery days, reviewers and margin week
Goal card · decision ladder · CxO influence map
Evidence legend · source register · mentor calendar

svg.text: PASS: ask fits one sentence; rollout is explicitly out of scope

text.tspan: • Trace original brief, addendum, BRD and laws
• Separate facts, scenarios, targets and unknowns
• Check MEES, Awaab’s Law, PAS 2035 and UK GDPR
• Label guidance separately from legislation
Claim matrix · dated rule-source register
Assumption backlog · initial executive risk register

svg.text: PASS: no unsupported core claim; contested claims are removed

text.tspan: Asset Executive · Building Safety Lead
Retrofit Programme Manager · Housing Officer
Resident/property journey · 15-stage lifecycle
Authority matrix · ranked binding constraints
GATE A: if problem + decision do not fit one sentence,
discard solution framing and restart with discovery
Finance · Procurement · Resident Engagement
Data & Performance
Process change · workflow/BI · bounded AI control plane
Original five-agent concept

svg.text: Options appraisal · synthetic-data spec · benefits scorecard

text.tspan: Actors · systems of record · trust boundaries
Deterministic controls · human decisions · analytics
Bounded AI · manual fallback
High-level architecture · target operating model
Architecture decisions · executive recommendation
GATE B: kill five-agent-first unless it uniquely beats
simpler process, workflow or BI alternatives
Mentor · architecture · sector · privacy
No new features or discretionary scope
Accept: freeze concept
Repair: bounded correction and repeat check
Restart: rebuild rejected value/boundary assumption
Stop: fall back to evidence/readiness proposition

svg.text: PROTECTED BUFFER: medium-level design cannot start rejected

text.tspan: Adapters · identity reconciliation · lifecycle events
Dated rules · state machine · work queues
Evidence ledger · assistants · approvals · analytics
Audit · observability · rollback and replay
Component diagram · data/event flow · trust boundaries
Failure and manual-fallback paths · decisions

svg.text: PASS: no AI component can take irreversible action
Generate evidence and gate the demo

text.tspan: ~500 properties · 12 months · hidden ground truth
Capacity, resident, supplier, evidence and quality constraints
Manifest · dictionary · deterministic validation

svg.text: Mentor accepts or rejects specification before code is retained

text.tspan: GATE C: build only if data validates, reset is clean,
scenario fits 6 minutes and adds decision evidence
Build property timeline + portfolio constraint queue
Show safety control + source-linked AI summary
Discard design and code; rebuild from clean criterion
At midpoint failure, stop coding and use static fallback

svg.text: Test the pitch, then build the deck

text.tspan: Decision recall · evidence trust · architecture clarity
Scorecard logic · demo value · stop conditions
Integrate slide-ready modules from Sessions 1-9
Proxy test · bounded opening rewrite · notes · reconciliation
GATE D: if proxy cannot repeat ask, evidence and stops,
rewrite once; if recall still fails, remove demo + simplify
Post-30 Nov regulatory delta check only
Reconcile resulting changes · one timed rehearsal
Verify accepted demo + fallback once · freeze package
Frozen deck + notes · regulatory review
Ratified or explicitly provisional benefits scorecard
GATE E: no prototype rebuild; kill unreliable live demo;
freeze all discretionary scope
Minor corrections · accessibility · packaging · backup
One confidence rehearsal · no new scope or rebuild
Approval · conditional approval · evidence request · rejection
Conditions · named owners · dates · next gate
MARGIN PROTECTED: core package passed by 5 Dec;
do not infer approval from applause or positive feedback

svg.text: Final one-hour C-suite run of show
Approve capped readiness and shadow-pilot design. Do not approve live deployment, autonomous authority or portfolio capital release.
Presentation trust outranks working code. Static evidence replaces any demo that is unsafe, unclear, network-dependent or unreliable.
Human-only authority: consent · safety · professional outputs · procurement · finance · grants · payment · quality acceptance
Core design principle: deterministic lifecycle and evidence controls first; bounded AI may only recommend, draft, reconcile and flag.
